1: # Tasks — home-terminal
2: 
3: Ordered so each phase typechecks on its own. Phase 1 adds the `kind` discriminator to the model + persistence,
4: Phase 2 makes `init` ensure + activate Home, Phase 3 adds the non-deletable guards, Phase 4 does the surfacing
5: (Home as a top-level **TitleBar** entry excluded from the rail + `⌘0` shortcut, and the rail owns onboarding),
6: Phase 5 removes the central empty pane + re-verifies repo-assuming guards and the anti-crash selector rule,
7: Phase 6 tests, Phase 7 verifies build/lint + the real app.
8: 
9: **Surfacing note (revised):** Phase 4 was initially planned as a **pinned Home entry inside the rail** (above
10: the groups). Per user decision, Home was moved **out of the rail entirely** into a top-level **TitleBar** entry
11: (labelled `~`, visible even when the rail is collapsed), plus a `⌘0` shortcut. The rail now only *excludes* Home
12: from its groups; it no longer renders a Home entry. The tasks below are marked `[x]` reflecting the **TitleBar**
13: implementation as shipped and gate-verified. See design.md D6.
14: 
15: **Reconcile-on-logic note:** this builds on the just-landed `empty-startup-state` `init` (contextless boot →
16: `workspaces = []`, `activeWs = null`). This change **supersedes that at boot**: contextless boot now lands on the
17: Home terminal (`activeWs = homeWs.id`), not `null`. Because `activeWs` is now never `null` after `init`, the
18: central `EmptyState` pane is unreachable and is **deleted** (component + import + `App.tsx` branch); its
19: onboarding moves into the rail (design.md D5). The `activeWs: string | null` / `initialized` store shape from
20: `empty-startup-state` **stays**. Reconcile by logic, not line numbers.
21: 
22: **Designer note:** Phase 4 defines the TitleBar Home entry's *contract* (top-level TitleBar entry after the
23: window controls, separated by a hairline, visible even when the rail is collapsed, active state, no trash,
24: labelled `~`, reachable via `⌘0`) **and** the rail-onboarding contract (rail owns "add repo / create
25: workspace"). Their visual treatment (the `~` glyph styling, hairline, active indicator; onboarding copy/layout)
26: is a **designer** surface (`/frontend-design`). The collapsed-rail switcher question is now **moot** — Home lives
27: in the TitleBar and is always accessible regardless of the rail's state (design.md Open Questions). Keep to
28: existing tokens; no new dependency.
29: 
30: ## 1. Model + persistence (`src/state/store.ts`, `src/lib/workspace.ts`)
31: 
32: - [x] 1.1 Add `kind: "home" | "workspace"` to `interface Workspace`. Existing/created lanes are
33:       `kind: "workspace"`.
34: - [x] 1.2 Add optional `kind?: "home" | "workspace"` to `CreateWorkspaceOpts`; in `newWorkspace`, set
35:       `kind: opts.kind ?? "workspace"`.
36: - [x] 1.3 In `rehydrate`, read `p.kind`, defaulting a missing/legacy value to `"workspace"`
37:       (`kind: p.kind ?? "workspace"`).
38: - [x] 1.4 In `src/lib/workspace.ts`: add `kind: "home" | "workspace"` to `PersistedWs`; write `w.kind` in
39:       `savePersisted`; in `loadPersisted`, tolerate legacy records (no `kind`) — the field is optional at read
40:       time and `rehydrate` defaults it. Confirm existing `savePersisted(...)` call sites still typecheck.
41: 
42: ## 2. `init` ensures and activates Home (`src/state/store.ts`)
43: 
44: - [x] 2.1 After `const workspaces = boot.restored.map(rehydrate)`, **ensure Home**: `let homeWs =
45:       workspaces.find(w => w.kind === "home")`; if absent, `homeWs = newWorkspace({ kind: "home",
46:       repoId: null, title: "Home", dir: home, branch: null, baseBranch: "" })` and `workspaces.unshift(homeWs)`.
47:       Match on `kind === "home"`, never on id/dir, so a restored Home is reused (not duplicated).
48: - [x] 2.2 Keep the existing repo-boot-lane logic (`if (boot.repo) { … bootWs … }`) unchanged.
49: - [x] 2.3 Change `activeWs` resolution so a contextless boot lands on Home, not `null`:
50:       `boot.activeWs (must exist in workspaces) → else bootWs?.id → else homeWs.id`. The `?? null` empty-state
51:       branch is **removed** as the boot outcome (Home is always the floor).
52: - [x] 2.4 Keep the mount loop `for (const w of workspaces) w.mounted = w.id === activeWs;` — Home mounts when it
53:       is active.
54: - [x] 2.5 Keep `set({ …, initialized: true })` and `savePersisted(workspaces, activeWs)` (now Home is included
55:       and `activeWs` is never `null` at boot). Confirm `deriveRepos` does not derive a repo from Home
56:       (`repoId: null` is already ignored — verify by reading `deriveRepos`).
57: 
58: ## 3. Non-deletable guards (`src/state/store.ts`, `src/lib/teardown.ts`)
59: 
60: - [x] 3.1 In `removeWorkspace`, before the existing `length <= 1` logic, refuse when the target is Home:
61:       find the workspace, and if `kind === "home"` `return {}` (no-op). Keep the `length <= 1` guard.
62: - [x] 3.2 In `deleteWorkspace` (`lib/teardown.ts`), early-return a refusal for `kind === "home"` **before** the
63:       length/worktree/PTY-kill steps (e.g. `{ ok: false, error: "the Home terminal cannot be removed" }`).
64: - [x] 3.3 Confirm no adopt-repo path can convert Home into a repo lane: read `adoptRepo` and guard it (or
65:       confirm it is never called for Home) so a `kind: "home"` workspace never gains a `repoId`. **Guarded**:
66:       `adoptRepo` is reachable from `App.tsx`'s cwd-change effect for ANY `repoId: null` workspace (including
67:       Home, which has `repoId: null` by design) — added an explicit `ws.kind === "home"` refusal in `adoptRepo`
68:       itself (this is a real gap the design flagged, not scope creep).
69: 
70: ## 4. Surfacing: Home in the TitleBar (`⌘0`), excluded from the rail; rail owns onboarding (`src/components/TitleBar.tsx`, `src/lib/keymap.ts`, `src/components/WorkspaceRail.tsx`)
71: 
72: - [x] 4.1 Select the Home workspace with a **stable-ref** selector wherever it is needed (TitleBar, rail):
73:       derive it from the already-subscribed `workspaces` array (e.g. `const homeWs = workspaces.find(w => w.kind
74:       === "home")`) — do NOT add a new `useStore(s => s.workspaces.find(...))` selector that could return a fresh
75:       value pattern (see 5.5).
76: - [x] 4.2 Exclude Home from grouping: filter `shown` (and thus the per-repo groups and the `manual`/`local`
77:       bucket, `WorkspaceRail.tsx:415-429`) to `w.kind !== "home"`. Home must not appear in any repo group nor in
78:       `local`. `groups.length === 0` then means "no non-Home workspaces".
79: - [x] 4.3 Render the **Home entry as a top-level TitleBar button** (`src/components/TitleBar.tsx`), placed after
80:       the traffic-light window controls and set apart by a hairline divider, **always visible even when the rail
81:       is collapsed** (contract only — designer refines). Label is **`~`** with a descriptive `aria-label`/`title`
82:       (the `title` announces `⌘0`). It shows active state (`activeWs === homeWs.id`, via `aria-current`) and calls
83:       `switchWorkspace(homeWs.id)` on click. It exposes **no trash affordance**. *Revised*: initially planned as a
84:       pinned rail entry; moved to the TitleBar per user decision (design.md D6).
85: - [x] 4.3b Add the **`⌘0`** shortcut in `src/lib/keymap.ts`, in the pane-independent `⌘` block (alongside
86:       `⌘,`/`⌘K`/`⌘B`, above the active-pane bail so it works regardless of pane focus): find the
87:       `kind === "home"` workspace and `switchWorkspace` to it. **Done** — handler added; the TitleBar button's
88:       `title` advertises it.
89: - [x] 4.4 Hide/disable the trash/delete affordance for `ws.kind === "home"` wherever a card renders it
90:       (belt-and-suspenders with 3.1/3.2). Confirm the card does not subscribe to a selector returning a fresh
91:       array/object each render (see 5.5). Note: the inline `WorkspaceCard` lives in `WorkspaceRail.tsx` (no
92:       separate file) — guard added there; but since Home is now a **TitleBar** entry and is filtered out of the
93:       rail entirely (4.2), Home never renders through `WorkspaceCard` at all, so this is pure belt-and-suspenders.
94: - [x] 4.5 **Rail owns onboarding.** Turn the existing empty region (`WorkspaceRail.tsx:543-555`, currently just
95:       `"no workspaces yet"` / `"no workspace matches …"`, shown when `groups.length === 0`) into the onboarding
96:       surface: a primary **Add repository** action (reuse the footer's `onAddRepo` / `addRepoFromFolder` with its
97:       `addBusy`/`addError` handling, ~L590+) and, when `useStore(s => s.repos.length) > 0`, a secondary
98:       **Create a workspace** action (`openCommand()`). Keep the `q`/filter branch (`"no workspace matches …"`)
99:       when a filter is active — onboarding is for the truly-empty case, not the filtered-empty case. No central
100:       pane involved. (Selector for `repos.length` returns a primitive → safe per 5.5.) **Note**: the existing
101:       footer "Add repository" control was left as-is (primary action always visible in the footer, unchanged);
102:       the new onboarding block adds its own copy + the secondary "Create a workspace" action inline in the empty
103:       region, above the unchanged footer. See the reviewer/tester note below on the "Create a workspace" branch's
104:       reachability.
105: - [x] 4.6 Hand the TitleBar Home entry **and** the rail onboarding to the **designer** for visual refinement
106:       (the `~` glyph styling, hairline divider, active indicator; onboarding copy/layout). The collapsed-rail
107:       switcher question is **moot** — Home lives in the TitleBar, always accessible regardless of the rail's
108:       state (design.md Open Questions). Keep the Phase-4 contract intact; existing tokens only; no new dependency.
109:       **Handoff pending** — contract implemented with plain inline styles matching existing conventions; final
110:       visual pass not done here (designer surface, per instructions).
111: 
112: ## 5. Remove the central empty pane + consumer regression review (`src/App.tsx`, then read-only)
113: 
114: - [x] 5.1 **Delete the central empty-state pane.** In `src/App.tsx`: remove the `EmptyState` import (L15), and
115:       replace the `hasActiveWs ? (context+tabs+panes) : <EmptyState/>` branch (L269-277) with the terminal
116:       column rendered unconditionally (`<WorkspaceContextBar/><TabStrip/><PaneArea/>`), since Home is always
117:       active. Drop the now-unused `hasActiveWs` selector (L42) if nothing else reads it (grep first). Then
118:       **delete `src/components/EmptyState.tsx`** and confirm no remaining import references it
119:       (`grep -rn EmptyState src`). TypeScript build must stay clean. Also removed the now-orphaned
120:       `__tests__/EmptyState.cov.test.tsx` and the dead `.aurora-empty` / `.aurora-empty__caret` /
121:       `.aurora-empty-secondary` CSS (kept `.aurora-empty-primary`, still consumed by `WorkspacesIntro.tsx`).
122: - [x] 5.2 Confirm repo-assuming guards short-circuit for Home (`repoId: null`): `servers.ts` `runServers`
123:       (`if (!ws.repoId) return`), `teardown.ts` (`if (w.repoId != null)` worktree path), `WorkspaceRail`/
124:       `WorkspaceCard` trash guard (`!ws.repoId || ws.dir === ws.repoId`), `create.ts`/`scripts.ts` repo reads.
125:       Confirm none throw or offer a repo action for Home. **Confirmed by reading** — no changes needed beyond
126:       the explicit `adoptRepo` guard (3.3).
127: - [x] 5.3 Confirm engine call sites that iterate `s.workspaces` tolerate a `kind: "home"` member:
128:       `activeWorkspace`/`activeGroup`/`activePane`, `patchPane`, `patchActiveWs`, `findPane`, `workspaceOfPane`,
129:       `allRepoRoots`, `PaneArea`, `TabStrip`. (All are repoId-agnostic; Home is a normal workspace to them —
130:       confirm by reading, no change expected.) **Confirmed by reading — no changes needed.**
131: - [x] 5.4 Confirm the mount/prune effects in `App.tsx` (the stale-restored-workspace prune, and the
132:       `wsDir`/`wsBase` effects reading `activeWorkspace(s)?.…`) still behave with Home always present and active;
133:       the prune must **never** remove the Home terminal (Home is not a restored orphan). Read to confirm.
134:       **Confirmed**: the prune operates on `persisted.workspaces` (the raw localStorage list) before `init` runs;
135:       Home is synthesized/reused inside `init` itself, entirely independent of the prune — updated
136:       `App.cov.test.tsx`'s prune test to assert Home survives alongside the pruned/kept lanes.
137: - [x] 5.5 **Anti-crash non-regression (known black-screen bug):** verify every selector added for Home returns a
138:       **stable reference** — no `useStore(s => …)` that fabricates a fresh `[]`/`{}`/object each render. Home is
139:       derived from the already-subscribed `workspaces` (stable) or from primitives (`s.activeWs`, `repos.length`,
140:       an id). Grep the touched components for new `useStore(` calls and confirm each returns a primitive or an
141:       existing ref. (This is the infinite-render-loop bug from the memory note — treat as a hard gate.)
142:       **Verified**: only two new `useStore(` calls added — `s.switchWorkspace` (stable action ref) and
143:       `s.repos.length > 0` (primitive boolean); `homeWs` itself is derived via plain `.find()` on the
144:       already-subscribed `workspaces` array, outside any selector.
145: 
146: ## 6. Tests (`__tests__/`, `bun:test`)
147: 
148: - [x] 6.1 `init` — contextless boot: Home exists and is active (`activeWs === homeWs.id`, NOT `null`) — the
149:       empty-pane outcome no longer exists. (`store.cov.test.tsx`, `storeCommand.test.ts`)
150: - [x] 6.2 `init` — repo boot: Home exists but the repo lane is active; Home is present and not focused.
151:       (`store.cov.test.tsx`, `storeCommand.test.ts`)
152: - [x] 6.3 `init` — restored Home is reused, not duplicated (exactly one `kind: "home"` after init when a Home
153:       was persisted). (`store.cov.test.tsx`, `storeCommand.test.ts`)
154: - [x] 6.4 `init` — legacy persisted data with no `kind` loads without error, entries are `kind: "workspace"`,
155:       and a Home is ensured. (`store.cov.test.tsx`)
156: - [x] 6.5 `removeWorkspace(homeWs.id)` is a no-op (Home remains); `deleteWorkspace` refuses Home before any
157:       teardown. (`store.cov.test.tsx`, `teardown.test.ts`, `storeCommand.test.ts`)
158: - [x] 6.6 Rail grouping excludes Home from every repo group and from the `local` bucket (unit-test the grouping
159:       derivation with a Home + repo workspaces + a manual lane). Also assert the onboarding-empty case: with only
160:       Home present, `groups.length === 0` (so the rail shows the "add repository" onboarding, not a repo group).
161:       (`WorkspaceRail.cov.test.tsx`) **Note**: the spec's "Create a workspace offered once repositories exist"
162:       scenario (spec.md, Scenario) assumes a state — `repos.length > 0` AND `groups.length === 0` outside a
163:       filter — that is structurally unreachable given the existing "every known repo gets its own group" loop; a
164:       registered repo always renders its own (possibly empty) group, so onboarding's secondary action is only
165:       reachable in that filtered-to-nothing branch, which task 4.5 explicitly keeps on the "no workspace matches"
166:       message instead. Implemented per the literal task 4.5 condition (`groups.length === 0`); documented as a
167:       discrepancy for architect/reviewer sign-off rather than silently forcing a different condition.
168: - [x] 6.7 Follow the existing test-colocation convention used by `empty-startup-state` (real-store import must
169:       survive the full run — other files' `mock.module("../src/state/store", …)` leaks globally under raw
170:       `bun test`; the canonical runner is `bun test/cov.ts`, which isolates files). New store/rail/app tests were
171:       added to the existing colocated real-store files (`store.cov.test.tsx`, `storeCommand.test.ts`,
172:       `WorkspaceRail.cov.test.tsx`, `App.cov.test.tsx`) and the module-mocked `teardown.test.ts`; the TitleBar +
173:       `⌘0` tests live in `TitleBar.cov.test.tsx` / `keymap.cov.test.tsx`. Canonical `bun test/cov.ts` confirmed
174:       green (1530 pass / 0 fail).
175: - [x] 6.8 **TitleBar + `⌘0` surfacing tests.** (a) `TitleBar.cov.test.tsx`: the `~` Home button renders as a
176:       top-level entry when a Home terminal exists (independent of the rail), shows `~`, reflects active state
177:       (`aurora-titlebar-home--active`), switches to Home on click, and renders **no** `~` button when no Home
178:       exists. (b) `keymap.cov.test.tsx`: `⌘0` jumps to the Home terminal even with a different workspace active
179:       (resolves Home via `kind === "home"`). **Done** — both suites present and green under `bun test/cov.ts`.
180: 
181: ## 7. Gates (build / lint / typecheck / real app)
182: 
183: - [x] 7.1 `bun run build` is clean (TypeScript strict — the new `kind` field must be exhaustively handled where
184:       the compiler flags it). **Verified**: `tsc && vite build` — clean.
185: - [x] 7.2 ESLint clean (`eslint.config.mjs`). **Verified**: `eslint src` — zero problems.
186: - [x] 7.3 Test suite green (new tests + existing suite) via the **canonical isolation runner** `bun test/cov.ts`
187:       (raw `bun test` mis-reports due to the documented global `mock.module` leak). **Verified**: 1530 pass /
188:       0 fail across 66 files, RESULT: GREEN (includes the new TitleBar `~` + `⌘0` tests).
189: - [x] 7.4 Confirm `cargo build` still clean (no Rust change expected — this is a guard, not new work).
190:       **Verified**: `git status --porcelain src-tauri/` empty (no Rust files touched); `cargo build` clean
191:       (321 crates compiled).
192: - [ ] 7.5 **Real-app check (WKWebView — cannot be confirmed by jsdom/tests):** launch the app; verify (a) a
193:       fresh contextless boot opens directly onto the Home terminal (no central empty pane, shell in `~`),
194:       (b) the Home `~` entry sits in the **TitleBar** (after the window controls, past a hairline), stays visible
195:       when the rail is collapsed, and is absent from the rail's repo/`local` groups, (c) with no repos/workspaces
196:       the rail shows the "add repository" onboarding while the Home terminal is still live in the content area,
197:       (d) Home has no trash affordance and cannot be removed, (e) switching Home ↔ a workspace (by click **and**
198:       via `⌘0`) shows each one's tabs/panes, (f) after relaunch Home returns as a fresh `~` terminal (not
199:       duplicated). Hand the visual pass to the **designer**. **NOT DONE by implementer** — explicitly out of
200:       scope per task instructions (static gates only; real-app WKWebView verification is the tester's job next).
